items.source: inheritable - whether to expose the LocaleContext as inheritable for child threads (using an InheritableThreadLocal)
items.translation: inheritable - 是否将 LocaleContext 作为可继承项暴露给子线程（使用 InheritableThreadLocal）

items.source: The given LocaleContext may be a TimeZoneAwareLocaleContext, containing a locale with associated time zone information.
items.translation: 给定的 `LocaleContext` 可能是一个 `TimeZoneAwareLocaleContext`，其中包含带有关联时区信息的区域设置。

items.source: Will implicitly create a LocaleContext for the given Locale, not exposing it as inheritable for child threads.
items.translation: 将隐式地为给定的 Locale 创建一个 LocaleContext，不将其暴露为可被子线程继承。

items.source: Will implicitly create a LocaleContext for the given Locale.
items.translation: 将隐式地为给定的 Locale 创建一个 LocaleContext。

items.source: localeContext - the current LocaleContext, or null to reset the thread-bound context
items.translation: localeContext - 当前的 LocaleContext，或为 null 以重置线程绑定的上下文。

items.source: locale - the current Locale, or null to reset the locale part of thread-bound context
items.translation: locale - 当前区域设置，或为 null 以重置线程绑定上下文的区域设置部分

items.source: timeZone - the current TimeZone, or null to reset the time zone part of the thread-bound context
items.translation: timeZone - 当前时区，或设为 null 以重置线程绑定上下文的时区部分

items.source: localeContext - the user-level locale context to check
items.translation: localeContext - 要检查的用户级区域设置上下文

items.source:
the current Locale, or the system default Locale if no
specific Locale has been associated with the current thread
items.translation: 当前区域设置，或者如果未将特定区域设置关联到当前线程，则为系统默认区域设置。

items.source:
the current TimeZone, or the system default TimeZone if no
specific TimeZone has been associated with the current thread
items.translation: 当前时区，或者如果未将特定时区关联到当前线程，则为系统默认时区。

items.source: Note: This method has a fallback to the shared default TimeZone, either at the framework level or at the JVM-wide system level. If you'd like to check for the raw LocaleContext content (which may indicate no specific time zone through null), use getLocaleContext() and call TimeZoneAwareLocaleContext.getTimeZone() after downcasting to TimeZoneAwareLocaleContext.
items.translation: 注意：此方法具有回退到共享默认时区的功能，无论是在框架级别还是 JVM 级系统级别。如果您想检查原始 LocaleContext 内容（可能通过 null 表示没有指定时区），请使用getLocaleContext()，并在向下转换为TimeZoneAwareLocaleContext后调用TimeZoneAwareLocaleContext.getTimeZone()。

items.source: Note: This method has a fallback to the shared default Locale, either at the framework level or at the JVM-wide system level. If you'd like to check for the raw LocaleContext content (which may indicate no specific locale through null, use getLocaleContext() and call LocaleContext.getLocale()
items.translation: 注意：此方法具有回退到共享默认 Locale 的功能，无论是在框架级别还是 JVM 级系统级别。如果您想检查原始的 LocaleContext 内容（可能通过 null 表示没有特定的 locale），请使用getLocaleContext()并调用LocaleContext.getLocale()。

items.source: NOTE: This can be useful to set an application-level default locale which differs from the JVM-wide default locale. However, this requires each such application to operate against locally deployed Spring Framework jars. Do not deploy Spring as a shared library at the server level in such a scenario!
items.translation: 注意： 这可用于设置与 JVM 级默认区域设置不同的应用程序级默认区域设置。然而，这需要每个此类应用程序针对本地部署的 Spring Framework jar 文件进行操作！在此类场景中，切勿在服务器级别将 Spring 作为共享库进行部署！

items.source: NOTE: This can be useful to set an application-level default time zone which differs from the JVM-wide default time zone. However, this requires each such application to operate against locally deployed Spring Framework jars. Do not deploy Spring as a shared library at the server level in such a scenario!
items.translation: 注意： 这可用于设置与 JVM 全局默认时区不同的应用程序级默认时区。然而，这需要每个此类应用程序针对本地部署的 Spring Framework jar 文件运行。在此类场景中，请勿在服务器级别将 Spring 作为共享库进行部署！

items.source:
Used as a central holder for the current Locale in Spring,
wherever necessary: for example, in MessageSourceAccessor.
DispatcherServlet automatically exposes its current Locale here.
Other applications can expose theirs too, to make classes like
MessageSourceAccessor automatically use that Locale.
items.translation: 用作 Spring 中当前 Locale 的中心持有器，在需要时（例如在 MessageSourceAccessor 中）使用。DispatcherServlet 会自动在此处暴露其当前 Locale。其他应用程序也可以在此处暴露它们的 Locale，以便让 MessageSourceAccessor 等类自动使用该 Locale。

items.source: Return the Locale associated with the given user context, if any, or the system default Locale otherwise. This is effectively a replacement for Locale.getDefault(), able to optionally respect a user-level Locale setting.
items.translation: 返回给定用户上下文关联的区域设置（如有），否则返回系统默认区域设置。这实际上可替换为 Locale.getDefault()，能够可选地尊重用户级别区域设置。

items.source: Return the TimeZone associated with the given user context, if any, or the system default TimeZone otherwise. This is effectively a replacement for TimeZone.getDefault(), able to optionally respect a user-level TimeZone setting.
items.translation: 返回给定用户上下文关联的时区（如果有），否则返回系统默认时区。这实际上可以替代 TimeZone.getDefault()，能够可选地尊重用户级别的时区设置。

items.source: Return the LocaleContext associated with the current thread, if any.
items.translation: 返回当前线程关联的 LocaleContext（如果有）。

items.source: Reset the LocaleContext for the current thread.
items.translation: 重置当前线程的 LocaleContext。

items.translation: 将给定的 Locale 与当前线程关联，同时保留可能已设置的任何 TimeZone。

items.source:

preserving any Locale that may have been set already.
items.translation: 将给定的时区与当前线程关联，同时保留可能已设置的任何区域设置。

items.translation: locale - 默认区域设置（或为 null 表示无，此时查找将回退到Locale.getDefault()）

items.translation: timeZone - 默认时区（或为 null 表示无，此时查找将回退到 TimeZone.getDefault()）

as an alternative to the JVM-wide default locale.
items.translation: 在框架级别设置共享的默认区域设置，作为 JVM 范围默认区域设置的替代方案。
